1778-5006-6495-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Memnite is starting in your graveyard.
1778-5006-6495-8170.description:
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Memnite spell. Then, activate Evereth by sacrificing Memnite, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat.
1778-5006-6495-8170.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

2645-3430-5475-7069.easyPrerequisites:
You control an untapped land.
Forensic Researcher doesn't have summoning sickness.
2645-3430-5475-7069.description:
Activate a land by using the land granted to it by Tectonic Split by tapping it, adding nine mana of any color due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, untapping the land.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

3968-4050-4078-5708.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 4 or higher.
3968-4050-4078-5708.description:
Activate Chainer by paying {B}{B}{B} and 3 life, returning Grave Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Grave Titan enters, it triggers, creating two 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing Grave Titan and the two Zombies, adding {B}{B}{B}
When Grave Titan and the Zombie tokens die, Vein Ripper triggers three times, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life for each trigger.
Repeat.

1733-2724-8172.description:
Activate Nephalia Smuggler by paying {3}{U} and tapping it, exiling and returning (at end step) Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Wormfang Manta entering does not cause its abillity to trigger due to Karn.
Repeat each turn.

2586-4186-4247.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Odric's Outrider triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability
Repeat

5702-7824--143.manaNeeded: {2}{G} plus enough mana to animate the land
5702-7824--143.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control a land that doesn't have summoning sickness and that can tap to produce at least {G}.
5702-7824--143.description:
Earthbend a land that can tap to produce at least {G}, thus animating it.
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated land.
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the land it is attached to due to Bard.
When the land tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the two land tokens by tapping them, adding at least {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and create two 1/1 Insect creature tokens due to Bard
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the land it is attached to due to Bard.
Repeat from step 5.

1580-4871-6797-7316.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Rat King trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1580-2438-4871-6112.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Fumulus trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1619-3967-4605-5542-6149.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-3967-4605-5542-6149.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Stirring Bard from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Stirring Bard enters, it and Preston trigger twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Stirring Bard.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Stirring Bard that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Stirring Bard token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Stirring Bard token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Stirring Bard that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the first Stirring Bard trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-3967-4605-5542-6149.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

895-2523-2869.description:
Activate Darigaaz's Attendant by paying {1} and sacrificing it.
When Darigaaz's Attendant dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Darigaaz's Attendant that is a 2/2 legendary Zombie in addition to its other types.
Repeat using the Darigaaz's Attendant token

1274-4094-4659-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites:
Kaya has two or more loyalty counters on it.
Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
1274-4094-4659-5086-5183.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

1308-2034-2279-5220-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
1308-2034-2279-5220-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Quintorius triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

394-1270-2034-5220-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
394-1270-2034-5220-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Desecrated Tomb triggers, creating three creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

2685-5078-6900.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or greater.
2685-5078-6900.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters the battlefield, Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent

568-1267-6541.description:
Deal combat damage using Medomai, triggering its ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
During your extra turn, cast Amphibian Downpour by paying {2}{U}, attaching it to Medomai.
Declare Medomai as an attacker, as it does not have its restriction due to Amphibian Downpour.
Holding priority, cast Capsize with buyback by paying {4}{U}{U}, returning Amphibian Downpour and Capsize to your hand.
Repeat from step 1.

1479-5033-6529.notablePrerequisites:
You are able to play a land this turn.
You have a land card in hand that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
1479-5033-6529.description:
Play any land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce {1}.
When the land enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Curse of the Restless Dead trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Curse of the Restless Dead trigger, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers.
Holding priority, activate the land played in step 1 by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Storm Cauldron triggers, returning the land from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting the land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Curse of the Restless Dead triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat from step 5.

618-1995-6252.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Boommobile with haste.
When the Boommobile token enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {W}{W}{W}{W} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Gauntlets of Light by paying {2}{W}, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.
618-1995-6252.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may instead target other creature(s) using Kiki-Jiki's ability or activate a Boommobile's ability to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

2187-4377-6122.notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Walk the Aeons and Possessed Skaab each turn.
2187-4377-6122.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Possessed Skaab by paying its mana cost.
When Possessed Skaab enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Possessed Skaab from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

997-1636-2527-3143.notablePrerequisites:
There is at least one counter on a permanent you control except Xavier Sal.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional nontoken Human, Fungus and/or Pirate that has no more than one +1/+1 counter on it.
997-1636-2527-3143.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from the additional nontoken Human, Fungus and/or Pirate if it has one, or any counter from another permanent you control otherwise.
Xavier Sal triggers, causing it and all other creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and gain undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Xavier Sal ability, causing you to populate.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the additional Human, Fungus and/or Pirate.
When the creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

851-2060-3490-3910-4017.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional artifacts.
851-2060-3490-3910-4017.description:
Activate Breya by paying {2} and sacrificing two other artifacts, causing you to gain 5 life.
Sunbond triggers, putting five +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Animation Module triggers, holding priority, activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create two 1/1 Servo artifact creature tokens.
Repeat.

618-2412-3525.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Crosis's's Attendant with haste.
Activate the Crosis's Attendant token by paying {1} and sacrificing it, adding {U}{B}{R}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.

1385-2173-2292-5220.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing it.
When Viscera Seer dies, Mortuary and Zulaport Cutthroat trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Viscera Seer from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Viscera Seer from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1247-4289-4893.notablePrerequisites: Pili-Pala does not have summoning sickness.
1247-4289-4893.description:
Activate Pili-Pala by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pili-Pala by paying {1} due to Training Grounds and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

678-1872-1976.description:
Activate Composite Golem by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
When Composite Golem dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Composite Golem to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Composite Golem by paying {5}.
Repeat.

1727-3359-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Moorland Rescuer.
Moorland Rescuer dies, triggering itself and Hofri Ghostforge.
Resolve the Hofri Ghostforge trigger, exiling Moorland Rescuer from your graveyard and creating a token copy of Moorland Rescuer that has "When this creature leaves the battlefield, return the exiled card to your graveyard".
Resolve the Moorland Rescuer trigger, returning nothing from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Moorland Rescuer token.
The Moorland Rescuer token dies, triggering itself twice.
Resolve the Moorland Rescuer token's trigger granted by Hofri Ghostforge, returning Moorland Rescuer from exile to your graveyard.
Resolve the other Moorland Rescuer trigger, returning Moorland Rescuer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment abilities from steps 1 and 5, dealing 2 damage to any target(s).
Repeat.

3055-3175-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Gift of Immortality from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Repeat.

539-1247-4974.notablePrerequisites: Pili-Pala does not have summoning sickness.
539-1247-4974.description:
Activate Pili-Pala by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Pili-Pala by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
